title: Service Delay on Approved Finish Items under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
**Clause.** A finish-item cash settlement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty carries a service-delay multiplier, applied to the program's cash-in-lieu maximum in the scheduled finish settlement. The service-delay multiplier counts the calendar days from the date of the most recent workmanship approval recorded on the coverage to the settlement date, the approval date itself not counted, and reads the missed-appointment charges assessed on the coverage within the last 6 calendar months (dated later than the same calendar day 6 months before the settlement date) less the charges waived within that same window:

- more days than the program's repair target days with no such unwaived charge standing takes 1.25;
- more days than the program's repair target days with at least one such unwaived charge standing takes 1.10;
- any other case takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

**Repair target days by program.**

| Program | Repair target days | Days counted that exceed it |
|---|---|---|
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard | 30 | 31 or more |
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Select | 30 | 31 or more |
| HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus | 30 | 31 or more |
| HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred | 21 | 22 or more |
| HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier | 21 | 22 or more |
| HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve | 14 | 15 or more |

| More days than the repair target days | Unwaived missed-appointment charge in the last 6 calendar months | Service-delay multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | None | 1.25 |
| Yes | At least one | 1.10 |
| No | Either | 1.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, 30 repair target days)

- Approval 1 March, settlement 31 March: 30 days counted, not more than 30, multiplier 1.00.
- Approval 1 March, settlement 1 April: 31 days counted. With no unwaived charge in the window, 1.25; with one charge assessed in the window and not waived, 1.10.
- Settlement on 20 September: a charge dated 20 March is outside the window, a charge dated 21 March is inside it.
